page.layout: One block of centred text at the top: a heading, then one paragraph. Below it at the right, the catchword "PRÆ-". Below that, a printer's ornament. The bottom dark bar and the digitiser's mark are not printed text.

main_text.head: RODOLPH. GOCL. AD LECT.
main_text.p: nam in corpore sano. Magnam enim in spem aliorum egregiorum ingenii huius speciminum isthæc Commentatio nos erexit. Marpurgi Idibus Iulii, Anni 1603.

page.notes: The first word "nam" is a sentence fragment carried over from the previous page, so it is left as a fragment. Long s is read as plain s throughout, so the printed "fano", "fpem", "fpeciminum" and "ifthæc" appear here as "sano", "spem", "speciminum" and "isthæc". The printer's ornament below the catchword is decorative and not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed.
